market.question: Will bitcoin hit $1m before GTA VI?

assessment.reasoning: BTC trades near $76K on April 30, 2026 — reaching $1M (a ~13x move) before July 31, 2026 is essentially impossible. GTA VI is officially set for Nov 19, 2026 release per Rockstar, after the July 31 cutoff. So neither side triggers and the market resolves 50-50 per its description, giving an effective YES probability of 0.5.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Possibility of a rare unannounced GTA VI release shift, but Rockstar just confirmed Nov 19, 2026 — extremely unlikely.
